Master Services Agreement
Between Jandira Technologies, LLC ("Jandira") and Halyard Press, Inc. ("the Client"), dated 3 March
2026.
1. Scope of services
Jandira will deliver the document redline engine described in statement of work 2026-04, in three
phases:
1. Discovery and fixture collection
2. Layout parity against Microsoft Word
3. Handover of the benchmark harness
Each phase ends with a written milestone report and a demonstration over the shared fixture corpus.
Work in one phase begins only after the Client accepts the previous milestone in writing.
2. Fees and schedule
Phase Deliverable Weeks Fee (USD)
1 Fixture corpus and 4 12,000
parity report
2 Layout engine parity 8 18,000
pass
3 Benchmark harness 3 9,000
handover
Total 15 39,000
Invoices are issued on milestone acceptance and are due net 30. Late payment bears interest at 1.0%
per month, to the extent permitted by law.
3. Confidentiality
Each party will keep the other's confidential information in confidence and use it only to perform this
agreement. This obligation survives termination by two years.
4. Term and termination
This agreement runs for twelve months from the date above and renews for successive three-month
terms unless either party gives thirty days' written notice. Either party may terminate for material
breach not cured within fifteen days of written notice.
5. Governing law
This agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to its conflict-of-law
provisions. Any dispute arising under it shall be settled by binding arbitration in New York County before
a single arbitrator under the CPR Rules.
Signed,
For Jandira Technologies, LLC — For Halyard Press, Inc.
